{{Quote|Clearly, you've never read about the Tech-Adepts' siege at Paigu. Their battle skills are as well-honed as their minds.|Varus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''siege at Paigu''' was a conflict that occurred at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Paigu]] and involved the [[Tech-Adepts]] of the planet [[Yablari/Legends|Yablari]]. The [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] Tech-Adepts fought during the conflict and earned a reputation as formidable warriors.
